Defeat Vorkath. This is a hard fight, so if you're unfamiliar with it it's recommended you watch a video on it first. Protect from Magic, and drink an antifire and antivenom potion. When Vorkath fires a pink fireball it'll turn your prayer off. When Vorkath shoots an orange fireball into the air, move away from the spot you're on. When Vorkath spits acid everywhere, WALK around to avoid the fireballs he will shoot. When Vorkath freezes you, kill the zombified spawn that appears before it reaches you.

Kill Galvek. This is a hard fight, so it's recommended you check a video to see what you'll have to do. Avoid the ground-targeted fireballs. The pink attack turns off prayer. Use Protect from Magic in phase 1, use Protect from Missiles otherwise. Phase 1 - Fire traps appear - if you go near them you die. Phase 2 - Fires transparent projectile which drains stats. Phase 3 - Waves of fire appear. Go through the gap in them to avoid. Phase 4 - Fires a binding projectile. Avoid it by moving.
